metadata.author: supabase
metadata.abstract: Comprehensive Postgres performance optimization guide for developers using Supabase and Postgres. Contains performance rules across 8 categories, prioritized by impact from critical (query performance, connection management) to incremental (advanced features). Each rule includes detailed explanations, incorrect vs. correct SQL examples, query plan analysis, and specific performance metrics to guide automated optimization and code generation.

nodes.label: service_role key rotation (only real revocation)
nodes.rationale: The embedded key is in published builds and git history; removing it from source does not revoke it, so rotating service_role in Supabase is the only revocation.

nodes.label: Edge Function admin-reset-app
nodes.rationale: reset_app deletes Auth users (auth.admin.deleteUser) which no DB RPC can do; must become a super-admin-gated Edge Function.

nodes.label: Edge Function admin-user-ops
nodes.rationale: Only the service role can call auth.admin.* (createUser/updateUserById/deleteUser); these Auth ops have no client/RLS path and must move to this global-admin-gated Edge Function.

nodes.label: PROPOSED_expenses_options.sql (Option A admin-only vs B manager team-scoped)
nodes.norm_label: proposed_expenses_options.sql (option a admin-only vs b manager team-scoped)
nodes.rationale: expenses RLS is admin-only today; routing manager writes to _client would be denied, so Option B adds a manager team-scoped policy (recommended).

nodes.label: RPC list_active_teams()
nodes.rationale: The handoff destination picker needs other teams which isolation RLS hides; a SECURITY DEFINER RPC returns active team ids/names/department for any authenticated user.

nodes.label: B3: get_profile_by_email unauthenticated PII lookup
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER with no caller check and no SET search_path returns the entire profiles row for any email, enabling enumeration/PII disclosure.

nodes.label: B4: init_client_task_visibility unauthorized write + spoofable actor
nodes.norm_label: b4: init_client_task_visibility unauthorized write + spoofable actor
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER with no role check; configured_by comes from a client-supplied argument, so a non-admin can create visibility rows attributed to any admin.

nodes.label: B5: Super Admin has no database-level authorization
nodes.norm_label: b5: super admin has no database-level authorization
nodes.rationale: Tier is granted client-side by a hardcoded email (ammar@cashback.com) rewriting role in memory; no is_super_admin column or RLS recognizes it, so the global tier is unverifiable at the DB and spoofable.

nodes.label: Row Level Security as the department boundary
nodes.norm_label: row level security as the department boundary
nodes.rationale: The database layer is the only real boundary; admins/super-admins are company-wide so department is a view scope for them, while managers/employees/clients must be DB-enforced.

nodes.label: guard_profile_privileged_fields trigger
nodes.rationale: Blocks a non-admin from changing their own role/status/team_id; must be updated to recognize super_admin if that role is added.

nodes.label: Proposed is_global_admin() helper
nodes.rationale: Replaces get_my_role()='admin' in admin policies so super-admins gain global access instead of being locked out when the role is introduced.

nodes.label: Privilege flags (team_privileges / user_privileges) are UI-only
nodes.rationale: RLS never reads the can_manage_* / can_view_finance flags; department boundaries are enforced through team-membership helpers, not the flags.

nodes.label: SECURITY DEFINER scoping helpers (my_team_id, manager_*_ids, get_my_role)
nodes.norm_label: security definer scoping helpers (my_team_id, manager_*_ids, get_my_role)

nodes.label: Unfiltered SECURITY DEFINER views (RLS bypass)
nodes.rationale: tasks_employee_view, admin_tables_overview, client_task_config_view run as owner (security_invoker unset) and are SELECTable by anon/authenticated with no row filter, exposing all tasks and configs across departments; unused by the app so safe to remediate.

nodes.label: user_role enum (admin, employee, client, manager)
nodes.rationale: super_admin was never added to the DB enum, so isSuperAdmin is always false at the data layer and the whole super-admin tier is inert in the database.

nodes.label: Company Cash Ledger (PROPOSED_company_ledger.sql)
nodes.rationale: Own company_ledger table with admin-only RLS; company_cash_balance() is admin-gated with EXECUTE revoked from public/anon/authenticated; the shared expenses table is not repurposed.

nodes.label: Finance Reset (wipe crm_* + expenses, 5 tables)
nodes.rationale: Hard DELETE (not TRUNCATE) in one transaction with pre/postconditions; all inbound FKs are RESTRICT within the set so no external cascade escapes scope.

nodes.label: PROPOSED_handoff_rpcs.sql (handoff_task / accept_handoff / reject_handoff)
nodes.rationale: Hardened RPCs with auth.uid check, source-team authority, active-dest check, FOR UPDATE lock, replay guard and audit; needed because handoff sets team_id=NULL which fails the manager WITH CHECK.

nodes.label: Embedded service_role key in Flutter client (TOP BLOCKER)
nodes.norm_label: embedded service_role key in flutter client (top blocker)
nodes.rationale: supabase_service.dart:12 hardcodes the service_role JWT and builds adminClient with it; it bypasses all RLS and ships in build/web and the APK, so isolation is bypassable until trusted ops move to Edge Functions and the key is rotated (removing from source does not revoke it).

nodes.label: Event reminders (send_event_reminders end-time + send_event_start_reminders)
nodes.rationale: End-time reminders fire at 60/5 min before end_time via a minute cron; start reminders need a separate config table (event_reminder_prefs) and send function so the live end-time system stays untouched.

nodes.label: Single shared dense calendar (department-scoped)
nodes.rationale: One calendar for all departments; 'calendars' = departments (team_id) so the workspace selector is reused instead of adding a calendars table.

nodes.label: handoffTask write gap (team_id=NULL fails manager WITH CHECK)
nodes.norm_label: handofftask write gap (team_id=null fails manager with check)

nodes.label: Service-role writes bypass RLS WITH CHECK (attendance/expense/task)
nodes.norm_label: service-role writes bypass rls with check (attendance/expense/task)
nodes.rationale: ALL policies already carry WITH CHECK, so routing writes through _client enforces scope; P2 is an app change, not a new migration.

nodes.label: Backend Security Plan (remove client service-role key)
nodes.norm_label: backend security plan (remove client service-role key)

nodes.label: Reuse teams table as departments
nodes.rationale: teams.department already exists, one team per department, all tasks carry team_id, and RLS/helpers/indexes are built around team_id; a parallel departments table + re-pointing 108 FKs would be large and risky for no gain at 1:1 scale.
